name: Butai Playhouse
description: Butai Playhouse is a documentary, photo-led WordPress theme designed for repertory theatres and performing arts venues selling five-play seasons. Built around Playfair Display and Source Sans 3 with a quiet ink and plum palette, it features full-bleed stage photography, horizontal season rails, flat colour-flood booking tiles, and fixed-price seat selection. It offers complete WooCommerce compatibility while operating cleanly as a standalone event and repertory ticketing site.
